args.content: Built the markdown TOC generator: it scans headings outside fenced code blocks, indents relative to the shallowest heading, and slugifies GitHub-style by lowercasing, stripping punctuation, and hyphenating spaces. The acceptance suite passes, including the code-fence exclusion and the punctuation slug case.

args.summary: Implemented markdown_toc.py to spec; acceptance suite green; summary.md delivered.
